provider_receipt.summary: Unsupported joined completion. The two dependency close receipts only state that workbench review closed; they provide no implementation findings, outputs, artifacts, checks, or underlying execution evidence against which the full approved objective can be judged. The second receipt also cites project contract digest sha256:d59bb85f29bca292fa4c541c5b2872b620afe557ffb0bf589a4fbb2ea149ed81, which differs from this node's supplied contract digest, without evidence establishing its applicability. The sole verification receipt proves only a clean tree, not objective satisfaction. Independent source inspection also found material unresolved defects: MemoryStore::store serializes and discards records rather than persisting them (src/lib.rs:56-88); slash-containing wikilinks are joined without confinement and may resolve outside the vault (src/lib.rs:184-192); and the implemented frontmatter schema conflicts with the documented ingestion contract, including numeric versus enumerated confidence and omitted required authority, privacy, provenance, and review fields (src/lib.rs:13-25; docs/human-knowledge-ingestion-contract.md:71-94). No files were modified and no declared checks were rerun.
